title: Full-stack feature wave delivery (contract-first, typed API 1:1)

steps.action: Pin the contract before code: typed API surface with JSON Schema descriptors generated from the same source the runtime uses
Implement server and client against the pinned contract in one wave; keep wire types 1:1 with the schema, no hand-copied second schema
Exercise the changed flow end to end in the browser the way a user would, including the surrounding routes that share the changed state
Verify empty and error states explicitly; a render screenshot alone is not verification

decision_hooks.criteria: The dispatched task adds or changes a user-visible web feature across server and client
